shortDescription: Get access-rule objects facts on Check Point over Web Services API

options.name: async_response
options.description: Run command in asynchronous mode and return task UID. Use show-task command to check the progress of the task. Available with customized HF.

options.name: dereference_group_members
options.description: Indicates whether to dereference "members" field by details level for every object in reply. Available from R80.10 management version.

options.name: details_level
options.description: The level of detail for some of the fields in the response can vary from showing only the UID value of the object to a fully detailed representation of the object.

options.name: filter
options.description: Search expression to filter the rulebase. The provided text should be exactly the same as it would be given in Smart Console. The logical operators in the expression ('AND', 'OR') should be provided in capital letters. If an operator is not used, the default OR operator applies.

options.name: filter_settings
options.description: Sets filter preferences. Available from R80.10 management version.

options.name: layer
options.description: Layer that the rule belongs to identified by the name or UID.

options.name: limit
options.description: No more than that many results will be returned. This parameter is relevant only for getting few objects. Valid values are between 1 and 500.

options.name: name
options.description: Object name. Should be unique in the domain.

options.name: offset
options.description: Skip that many results before beginning to return them. This parameter is relevant only for getting few objects.

options.name: order
options.description: Sorts results by the given field. By default the results are sorted in the ascending order by name. This parameter is relevant only for getting few objects.

options.name: show_as_ranges
options.description:
When true, the source, destination and services & applications parameters are displayed as ranges of IP addresses and port numbers rather than network objects.
Objects that are not represented using IP addresses or port numbers are presented as objects.
In addition, the response of each rule does not contain the parameters, source, source-negate, destination, destination-negate, service and service-negate, but instead it contains the parameters, source-ranges, destination-ranges and

options.name: show_membership
options.description: Indicates whether to calculate and show "groups" field for every object in reply. Available from R80.10 management version.

options.name: version
options.description: Version of checkpoint. If not given one, the latest version taken.

options.name: wait_for_task
options.description: Wait for the task to end. Such as publish task.

options.name: wait_for_task_timeout
options.description: How many minutes to wait until throwing a timeout error.
